hotels.title: Five-Star Chiang Mai Mountain Retreat by MGallery Collection
hotels.description: Set in the forested hills of Hang Dong, this MGallery retreat pairs contemporary Lanna design with sweeping views over terraced rice paddies and mountain-fringed valleys. The resort sits about 20 minutes from Chiang Mai Old City, where Wat Phra Singh, the Sunday Walking Street and the teakwood façades of historic lanes await. Days here drift between the dramatic infinity pool, a serene spa and refined Thai dining at The Higher Room, known for its elevated valley outlook. Closer to the city, Nimmanhaemin Road draws visitors with polished cafés, gallery spaces and northern Thai favourites such as khao soi at Khao Soi Nimman
